prompt:
The chart below shows the number of students enrolled in five subject areas at one college in 2010 and in 2022.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Student enrolment by subject area, 2010 and 2022
visual.alt: A bar chart comparing the number of students enrolled in five subject areas at one college for 2010 and 2022.

key_points: The largest subject area changes: business studies (880) was first in 2010, but computing (900) is first in 2022
Computing rises from 210 to 900, more than a fourfold increase — by far the largest rise
Health sciences rises from 420 to 760, nearly doubling, and moves into second place
Two areas fall: business studies from 880 to 640, and arts and design from 350 to 300; arts and design remains the smallest or close to the smallest in both years
Engineering is the most stable area, with a modest rise (640 to 700)
Total enrolment rises from 2,500 to 3,300, so the change is not only a shift between subjects but also overall growth
common_mistakes: Listing all five areas one by one without highlighting the two most striking changes (computing and business studies)
Not stating that the ranking changes
Describing student numbers as if they were percentages ('45% studied computing')
Adding comment or prediction ('computing will keep growing')
